title: WAMTA submission page data (submission.yml)
description: Drives the per-year /submission page rendered by _includes/submission.md.

nav_hidden.description: When true, the page stays reachable but is omitted from the top navigation. See _includes/header.html for nav resolution.

sections.description: Ordered list of titled content sections (Abstract submission, Proceedings submission, etc.).

show_contact.description: When true, renders the contact-us include below the submission content.

show_important_dates.description: When true, renders the Important Dates sidebar card on the submission page.
